source.text: A case with one fault: a burnup of 63 MWd/kgHM, above the 62 the conductivity model is valid for. FEED must refuse it before any run; SEED reports E_OUT_OF_RANGE.
source.check: FEED's schema vectors (schema/vectors/bad/burnup-above-range.json) assert the same code in FEED's own test suite.
